concerns.text: FR-001 requires generation of visual‑layout latents using a frozen visual encoder, but no task in tasks.md produces visual‑layout latents; the only latent generation is T003, which creates deterministic structural feature vectors.

FR-004 specifies concatenation of text embeddings with *visual* latents for downstream evaluation, yet the pipeline (T007, T009) concatenates text embeddings with *structural* latents. No task creates or uses visual latents.

FR-005 calls for evaluation on scientific reasoning tasks (e.g., Table QA) with paired statistical testing. All downstream tasks (T007‑T010) evaluate a regression label (overlap/CPU‑score) rather than a reasoning task, leaving FR‑005 uncovered.

FR-008 demands an ablation demonstrating that predicted visual latents contain information independent of the text‑only encoder. The only ablation (T009) reports `independence_claim_supportable: false`, indicating the claim is not demonstrated; thus the requirement is not satisfied.

SC-002 expects measurement of accuracy/F1, a classification metric, but the downstream evaluation (T007‑T010) reports regression metrics (numeric scores) with no accuracy/F1 values, so this success criterion is uncovered.
